column1: # !! READ BEFORE UNIT #001'S FIRMWARE IS FLASHED FOR SHIPMENT !!
# This is a SINGLE-SLOT partition table. There is an `otadata` partition and
# an `app0` (ota_0) slot
column2: but NO `app1` (ota_1). ESP-IDF / Arduino OTA refuses

column1: # to write without a second slot because rollback is impossible.
# Architecture: updates flow phone -> BLE -> S3 -> UART -> ESP32 main. The
# unit is never on WiFi or the internet (air gap is intentional
# README/MEMORY). BLE OTA still needs two app slots on the device.
# Once a unit ships with this single-slot layout
# dual-slot over the air -- by definition
column2: the OTA mechanism we'd use to push

column1: # the fix requires the second slot to already exist. The partition layout is
# baked into the factory firmware image at flash time. Decide BEFORE unit #001
# or accept that unit forever requires a service-visit reflash for any
# firmware change.
# Current binary is ~465 KB (well under the 0x90000 = 576 KB slot). Proposed
# dual-slot layout
#   nvs       data nvs    0x9000   0x5000
#   otadata   data ota    0xe000   0x2000
#   app0      app  ota_0  0x10000  0xC0000   (768 KB)
#   app1      app  ota_1  0xD0000  0xC0000   (768 KB)
#   spiffs    data spiffs 0x190000 0x270000  (~2.4 MB
# Cost: ~1 MB of LittleFS. Trade is worth it. The image store
# manifest
column2: and persistent logs all currently fit well under 2.4 MB.
